description: A department head must resolve recurring friction between Lina and Omar over a cross-team client handoff process. The head must decide whether they will continue sharing responsibility or move to distinct roles, then finalize the working method, meeting time, and support plan.

shared_context.S1: Lina and Omar currently share responsibility for handing client escalations from Client Operations to Implementation.
shared_context.S2: Several recent handoffs have led to disagreement about who communicates with the client and who owns the internal follow-up.
shared_context.S3: Priya has authority to change the responsibility structure and the team's recurring coordination process.
shared_context.S4: The department's weekly operating review includes a standing agenda item for escalation ownership, handoff timing, and support needs. During that agenda item, Priya routinely gives Lina and Omar each a designated turn to state relevant constraints and formally record any context that should affect the decision before Priya settles it.
shared_context.S5: A major client rollout is scheduled to begin in four weeks, making a stable handoff process important.

PF1.text: Before the previous department head left, Lina and that leader agreed informally that Lina would own client-facing escalation communication and Omar would own internal root-cause follow-up for six weeks; that six-week period has now passed, and the agreement was never added to the operating documentation.

PF2.text: Omar told Lina last week that he is managing burnout symptoms and cannot reliably join recurring meetings after 15:30. For the next four weeks he can attend a coordination meeting only on Tuesdays at 14:00, and he needs handoff details in writing before that meeting. He also specifically asked Priya for a private weekly wellbeing check-in during those four weeks, but has not yet raised that request with Priya.

agent_instructions.A3: When formally recording PF2, emit valid JSON with exactly the action type reveal, the fact_id PF2, and a text field. Do not put an extra quote after the colon in the type field. Use a reveal action rather than only mentioning PF2 in a say action.

acceptance_conditions: The shared responsibility must be replaced with distinct roles.
Lina must own client-facing escalation communication.
Omar must own internal root-cause follow-up.
The responsibility split must be added to the operating documentation.
Handoff details must be provided in writing before coordination.
The coordination meeting must occur on Tuesday at 14:00 for the first four weeks.
The arrangement must last four weeks before a review.
Priya must schedule a private weekly wellbeing check-in with Omar during the four-week period.

content_checks.C6: any(c.get('type') == 'operating_documentation_update' or c.get('type') == 'documentation_update' or c.get('type') == 'documentation' or c.get('type') == 'operating_documentation' or c.get('detail') == 'The split responsibility structure, handoff timing requirements, and written handoff format will be added to the department\'s operating documentation before the rollout begins.' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and any((c.get('type') == 'private_weekly_check_in' or c.get('type') == 'private_weekly_wellbeing_check_in' or c.get('type') == 'private_followup') and c.get('target') == 'Omar' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The prior undocumented agreement changes the responsibility assignment to Lina for client communication and Omar for internal follow-up, and changes the required commitment to documenting that split in the operating documentation.

Omar's specific four-week availability constraint fixes written handoffs before a Tuesday 14:00 meeting for exactly four weeks, and his support request changes the settlement by requiring a private weekly wellbeing check-in.
